north_star: Increase useful capability and performance together while keeping runtime/native artifacts fully reconstructible.
correctness_gate: Reference parity must hold before a performance result is eligible.
formal_convergence_rule: After all coarse regions exist, stop after 8 consecutive loops without >=1% Pareto improvement; never exceed 50 loops.
bounded_stop: The final run reached the 50-loop hard cap with 7 consecutive non-updates after the last >=1% update. Existing top candidates were then confirmatory-tested without adding new search candidates.
